column1: # ESP32-S3 layout. Sized to fit a 4 MB flash as well as the XIAO's 8 MB
# so the table never exceeds the flash espflash assumes (its default is
# 4 MB — a table that overflows it produces a header/size mismatch
# mismatched flash settings read back as garbage .rodata).
# The wake-word model (srmodels.bin) is ~285 KB; 512 KB leaves headroom.
